definition_zh: 偏见；偏向；偏差；使有偏见
definition_en: an unfair preference or a systematic slant in judgment, data, or design, or to influence something unfairly
core_image: 保龄球被做偏的一侧：球滚着滚着自己拐向一边
scene: 研究发布前，审稿人反复追问样本来源是否站得住脚。The study was criticized for a bias that favoured the sponsor's product.
sceneCN: 这里 bias 是「研究中的系统性偏差」（第 2 个义项：数据或方法偏向一方）；句意：这项研究因偏向赞助商产品而受到批评。场景要点：研究报告、赞助商标志、一边倒的数据图表。

collocations.zh: 斜着；沿斜纹方向（裁剪用语）

senses.title: Prejudice for or against a group
senses.titleCN: 偏见：对某群体先有立场
senses.definition: an unfair preference or dislike for a person or group based on identity rather than evidence
senses.definitionCN: 基于身份而非证据，对某人或某群体不公平的偏好或厌恶
senses.example: The hiring panel was accused of gender bias.
senses.exampleCN: 招聘小组被指存在性别偏见。
senses.why: The original bias was a weight placed off-centre on a bowling ball. The ball therefore curves one way; a mind with bias curves toward one group.
senses.whyCN: 最初的 bias 是保龄球上偏置的配重。球因此向一边拐；有 bias 的心也会向某个群体拐。

senses.title: Systematic distortion in data or research
senses.titleCN: 系统性偏差：数据整体偏了一边
senses.definition: a systematic error that makes results consistently differ from the truth in one direction
senses.definitionCN: 使结果持续朝一个方向偏离真实情况的系统性误差
senses.example: The survey suffered from selection bias because it only reached smartphone users.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查存在选择偏差，因为它只触及智能手机用户。
senses.why: A bowling ball with an off-centre weight does not make random errors; it curves the same way every time. Statistical bias is that consistent curve.
senses.whyCN: 偏置配重的保龄球不是随机出错，而是每次都朝同一边弯。统计偏差就是这种持续一致的弯曲。

senses.title: A personal leaning or tendency
senses.titleCN: 个人偏向：心里更倾向某一边
senses.definition: a preference or inclination that shapes how someone thinks or acts
senses.definitionCN: 影响一个人思考或行动方式的偏好或倾向
senses.example: He has a bias for simple solutions over complicated ones.
senses.exampleCN: 他偏向简单方案，而不是复杂方案。
senses.why: The curve need not be hostile; any off-centre weight makes the ball drift. In the same way, a mild preference is already a bias.
senses.whyCN: 这种弯曲不必带敌意；只要配重偏离中心，球就会漂。同样，温和的偏好也已经是一种 bias。

senses.title: An oblique line or grain
senses.titleCN: 斜线：布料或裁剪的斜向
senses.definition: a slanting direction, especially the diagonal grain of woven fabric or a cut made across it
senses.definitionCN: 倾斜的方向，尤指织物的斜纹或横过布纹的裁剪
senses.example: The dress was cut on the bias so that it would drape softly.
senses.exampleCN: 这条裙子沿斜纹裁剪，因此垂坠柔和。
senses.why: This is the oldest concrete sense: biais in Old French meant 'slant, oblique'. The line runs across the straight grain.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的实体义：古法语 biais 就是“倾斜、斜的”。这条线横过笔直的布纹。

senses.title: To influence unfairly
senses.titleCN: 使有偏见：把判断推向一边
senses.definition: to cause someone or something to favour one side unfairly
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某事物不公平地偏向一边
senses.example: The editor was accused of biasing the report against the opposition.
senses.exampleCN: 编辑被指让报道对反对派产生偏见。
senses.why: The verb applies the off-centre weight: a force is added to one side, so the result rolls that way.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是加上偏置配重：往一边施力，结果便朝那边滚。

senses.title: Electronics: a steady voltage or current
senses.titleCN: 电子学：偏置电压或电流
senses.definition: a fixed voltage or current applied to a device to set its operating point
senses.definitionCN: 施加于器件、用来设定其工作点的固定电压或电流
senses.example: The transistor needs a small bias voltage to conduct.
senses.exampleCN: 晶体管需要一个小偏置电压才能导通。
senses.why: The electrical sense keeps the geometry: the operating point is pushed away from the centre to one side so the device responds correctly.
senses.whyCN: 电子义保留了这种几何：工作点被从中心推向一边，器件才能正确响应。

senses.title: Cognitive bias
senses.titleCN: 认知偏误：思维自己走捷径
senses.definition: in psychology, a repeatable pattern in which judgment departs from logic or evidence
senses.definitionCN: 心理学中判断反复偏离逻辑或证据的模式
senses.example: Confirmation bias makes people notice evidence that supports what they already believe.
senses.exampleCN: 确认偏误使人更容易注意到支持自己既有信念的证据。
senses.why: The mind's default path is the off-centre weight. It saves effort but curves every judgment in the same direction.
senses.whyCN: 心智的默认路径就是那块偏置配重。它省力，却让每个判断都朝同一方向弯。

senses.title: Algorithmic or AI bias
senses.titleCN: 算法偏见：模型学进了偏差
senses.definition: a systematic unfairness in a model or system, usually learned from biased data or design choices
senses.definitionCN: 模型或系统中系统性的不公平，通常来自有偏差的数据或设计选择
senses.example: The chatbot showed bias because its training data underrepresented certain dialects.
senses.exampleCN: 这个聊天机器人表现出偏见，因为训练数据对某些方言代表性不足。
senses.why: A model repeats the curve it was trained on. If the data leaned one way, the machine leans the same way at scale.
senses.whyCN: 模型会重复它被训练时见到的弯曲。数据偏向一边，机器就会大规模地朝同一边偏。

senses.title: Media bias
senses.titleCN: 媒体偏向：报道框架有倾斜
senses.definition: a tendency in news reporting to present events from one perspective or to favour one side
senses.definitionCN: 新闻报道倾向于从某一视角呈现事件或偏袒某一方
senses.example: Readers complained about the paper's political bias.
senses.exampleCN: 读者抱怨这家报纸有政治偏向。
senses.why: Selection and framing act like an off-centre weight on the whole report: some facts are pushed forward, others are pushed out of view.
senses.whyCN: 选择与框架就像给整篇报道加了偏置配重：有些事实被推向前面，另一些被推出视野。

intro.en: Bias began as a word for a slanting line and became the name of a weighted bowling ball. From that curved roll came the modern senses of prejudice and systematic distortion.
intro.cn: bias 最初指一条斜线，后来成为偏置保龄球的名称。从那种弯曲的滚动，长出了现代“偏见”和“系统性偏差”的含义。

items.en: Bias enters English in the 1520s as 'an oblique or diagonal line'. The earliest uses are about cuts, slopes, and geometry.
items.cn: bias 在 1520 年代进入英语，意为“斜线、对角线”。最早用法与裁剪、斜面、几何有关。

items.en: By the 1560s a bias was also a weight placed on one side of a bowling ball so that it curved as it rolled. The bowl had a bias; the path showed it.
items.cn: 到 1560 年代，bias 也指保龄球一侧的配重，使球滚动时弯曲。球本身“有 bias”，轨迹把这一点显示出来。

items.en: The English word comes from Old French biais 'slant, slope, oblique'. French already used it for both a diagonal line and a leaning tendency.
items.cn: 英语这个词来自古法语 biais“倾斜、斜面、斜的”。法语中它已经既指斜线，也指倾向。

items.en: The deeper origin of biais is not settled. One suggestion traces it through Vulgar Latin *(e)bigassius to Greek epikarsios 'athwart, crosswise', from epi- 'upon' + karsios 'oblique'; this is a hypothesis, not an attested chain.
items.cn: biais 更深层的来源尚无定论。一种说法认为它经通俗拉丁语 *(e)bigassius 追溯到希腊语 epikarsios“横向的、斜穿过去的”，由 epi-“在上”+ karsios“斜的”构成；这只是假说，不是有文献链的结论。

items.en: By the 1570s bias was used for a leaning of the mind. A ball that curves became a judgment that curves; the weight moved from the bowl to the person.
items.cn: 到 1570 年代，bias 被用于表示心智的倾向。会弯的球变成了会弯的判断；配重从球上移到了人身上。

items.en: Statistics, psychology, electronics, media studies, and AI all use the same geometry: a system pushed off-centre, so that its output consistently leans one way.
items.cn: 统计学、心理学、电子学、媒体研究和人工智能都使用同一种几何：系统被推离中心，于是输出持续偏向一边。

note.en: The first group is built on the same bias; the second collects words for unfair leaning, each naming a different kind of tilt.
note.cn: 第一组建立在同一个 bias 上；第二组收“不公平倾向”的词，各自命名不同类型的倾斜。

entries.definition: showing an unfair preference. It is the past participle of bias used as an adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 表现出不公平偏好的。它是 bias 的过去分词转作形容词。

entries.definition: fair and without preference. Un- 'not' + biased removes the off-centre weight.
entries.definitionCN: 公正、无偏好的。un-“不”+ biased，去掉偏置配重。

entries.definition: plural of bias, or the third-person singular of the verb. It is not a different root.
entries.definitionCN: bias 的复数，或动词第三人称单数。它不是另一个词根。

entries.definition: an opinion formed before knowing the facts, especially about a group. It is usually social and emotional; bias can be statistical and neutral in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 在了解事实之前形成的看法，尤指对某群体。它通常带社会性和情绪性；bias 可以是统计性的、语气中性的。

entries.definition: unfair support for one person or side. It stresses favouring a particular party rather than a distorted system.
entries.definitionCN: 对某人或某一方的不公平支持。它强调偏袒特定一方，而不是系统被扭曲。

entries.definition: a particular point of view imposed on information, or a sloping direction. Slant is often used for media framing.
entries.definitionCN: 强加于信息的特定视角，或倾斜方向。slant 常用于媒体框架。

entries.definition: a general inclination to behave in a certain way. It is broader and can be neutral, while bias implies unfairness in most modern uses.
entries.definitionCN: 以某种方式行事的一般倾向。它更宽泛，可以中性；bias 在现代用法中多含不公平意味。

normalIntro.en: Real image and relatives: a bowling ball with an off-centre weight, the adjective biased, and the modern debias.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实意象与同族词：一侧加配重的保龄球、形容词 biased，以及现代词 debias。

normal.en: A bowling ball with a weight on one side curves as it rolls. That curve is the original bias.
normal.cn: 一侧加配重的保龄球滚起来会弯。那道弯曲就是最初的 bias。

normal.en: Biased is the adjective: a biased report has a weight on one side of its scale.
normal.cn: biased 是形容词：a biased report 的天平一侧被加了重量。

normal.en: Unbiased removes the weight, so the result can roll straight.
normal.cn: unbiased 去掉了那块配重，结果才能直着滚。

normal.en: To debias a model is to find and remove the off-centre weight in its training data.
normal.cn: debias 一个模型，就是找出并移除训练数据里的偏置配重。

normal.en: On the bias means diagonally across the grain of cloth, the oldest concrete sense.
normal.cn: on the bias 指沿斜纹横过布纹，这是最古老的实体义。

abstract.en: Bias is not the same as being wrong. It is a consistent direction of error, like a ball that always curves left.
abstract.cn: bias 不等于“错了”，而是一种持续一致的错误方向，像永远向左弯的球。

abstract.en: The weight can sit in a person, a dataset, a question, a newsroom, or a circuit. The geometry is identical.
abstract.cn: 配重可以放在一个人、一份数据、一道问题、一间新闻编辑室或一个电路里。几何关系完全相同。

abstract.en: Removing bias is not the same as having no perspective; it means no hidden weight is steering the result without being declared.
abstract.cn: 消除 bias 不等于没有视角；它意味着没有隐藏的配重在不声明的情况下操纵结果。

examples.en: The judge was asked to step aside because of a perceived bias.
examples.cn: 由于被认为存在偏见，法官被要求回避。

examples.en: The test was redesigned to remove cultural bias.
examples.cn: 这项测试被重新设计，以消除文化偏差。

examples.en: Social media algorithms can amplify political bias.
examples.cn: 社交媒体算法会放大政治偏向。

dict_mnemonic.text: “拜厄斯”——拜厄斯看人总先挑一边站，像偏心的保龄球 → bias 偏见、偏向

root: 源自古法语 biais“倾斜、斜面”；最初指斜线，16 世纪又指保龄球一侧的配重，球因此弯曲滚动，核心是“偏离中心、持续倒向一边”。更深词源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of bias, all built on one geometry: a weight placed off-centre, making the path curve consistently toward one side.
sensesIntro.cn: bias 的九个义项都建立在同一种几何上：配重偏离中心，使路径持续朝一边弯曲。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an off-centre weight that makes a ball, a judgment, or a system lean one way.
core.cn: 核心意象：偏离中心的配重，让球、判断或系统倒向一边。

branches.en: SOCIAL AND MEDIA LEANING: prejudice toward a group, a personal preference, a newsroom's framing.
branches.cn: 社会与媒体倾向：对群体的偏见、个人偏好、新闻编辑室的框架。

branches.en: SYSTEMATIC ERROR: selection bias, cognitive shortcuts, and learned algorithmic unfairness.
branches.cn: 系统性误差：选择偏差、认知捷径，以及算法学到的系统性不公。

branches.en: GEOMETRY: the original slant of a line or the diagonal grain of cloth.
branches.cn: 几何：最初的斜线，或布料的斜纹。

branches.en: THE VERB: to add the off-centre weight and push a result toward one side.
branches.cn: 动词：加上偏置配重，把结果推向一边。

branches.en: ELECTRONICS: a fixed voltage that sets an operating point away from centre.
branches.cn: 电子学：把工作点设定在偏离中心的固定电压。

intro.en: Bias is a borrowed French noun. English adds -ed, un-, -es, and -ing; modern technical English coins de- and -free compounds.
intro.cn: bias 是借入的法语名词。英语加 -ed、un-、-es、-ing；现代技术英语又造出 de- 和 -free 复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no reliable classical Latin word for bias. The suggested Vulgar Latin *(e)bigassius, linked to Greek epikarsios, is a hypothesis, so latinEntries is left empty rather than presenting a speculative root as fact.
latinIntro.cn: bias 没有可靠的古典拉丁语来源。所谓的通俗拉丁语 *(e)bigassius（与希腊语 epikarsios 相联系）只是假说，因此 latinEntries 留空，不把推测词根当作事实。

items.meaning: more than one bias, or 'it biases'
items.meaningCN: 多种偏见；或动词第三人称单数
items.example: The report identifies several hidden biases.
items.exampleCN: 报告指出了几处隐藏的偏见。

items.meaningCN: 有偏见的；偏向的（-ed 构成分词或形容词）
items.example: The sample was biased toward younger voters.

items.meaningCN: 无偏见的；公正的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: We need an unbiased review of the evidence.
items.exampleCN: 我们需要对证据进行公正的审查。

items.meaningCN: 使产生偏向；正在加偏置（-ing 构成分词）
items.example: The wording of the question was biasing the answers.
items.exampleCN: 问题的措辞正在使答案产生偏向。

items.meaning: the same as biasing, with doubled s
items.meaningCN: 与 biasing 同义，英式拼写双写 s

items.meaning: to remove a known bias from data or a process
items.meaningCN: 去偏；从数据或流程中消除偏差（de- 表示去除）
items.example: The team tried to debias the training set.
items.exampleCN: 团队试图去除训练集的偏差。

items.example: Debiasing is easier when the source of the skew is known.
items.exampleCN: 当偏差来源已知时，去偏会更容易。

items.meaning: designed or tested to contain no bias
items.meaningCN: 无偏差的；无偏见的（free 表示“没有”）
items.example: The company promised a bias-free hiring process.
items.exampleCN: 公司承诺采用无偏见的招聘流程。

items.meaning: to apply excessive bias in electronics or modelling
items.meaningCN: 过偏；施加过大的偏置（over- 表示“过度”，技术用语）
items.example: The amplifier was overbiased and overheated.
items.exampleCN: 放大器偏置过大，导致过热。
